inclusion_rule: Same intracranial imagined-speech decoder population. Design of interest: the decoded output unit of imagined trials: task versus rest, phoneme or vowel class, consonant class, whole-word identity, continuous acoustic features, sentence text. Boundary: word stimuli whose sub-word units are classified (Pei 2011) count as sub-word output. Population: human intracranial (ECoG, sEEG, depth, intracortical) decoders of imagined, covert or inner speech; excluded are attempted speech decoded from unit firing (Guenther 2009, Brumberg 2011), scalp EEG/MEG, listening-only reconstruction, overt-only studies, analyses without a decoder and reviews; versions count once. Priors: first public before 2015-11; [concurrent] 2015-11 to 2016-11. Pattern-match studies first public up to 2015 (Leuthardt 2011 undated in the index, resolved from its text): 8 unique; excluded listening-only (Pasley 2012, Yang 2015), no decoder (Leuthardt 2012 gamma time course), overt-only (Lotte 2015), leaving 4 decoders.

prior_tally.basis: Population: human intracranial (ECoG, sEEG, depth, intracortical) decoders of imagined, covert or inner speech; excluded are attempted speech decoded from unit firing (Guenther 2009, Brumberg 2011), scalp EEG/MEG, listening-only reconstruction, overt-only studies, analyses without a decoder and reviews; versions count once. Priors: first public before 2015-11; [concurrent] 2015-11 to 2016-11.
